title: Time Intelligence (YoY/MTD) & Executive Dashboard Design
summary: Build Year-over-Year growth, Month-to-Date metrics, Dynamic Row-Level Security (`USERPRINCIPALNAME`), and clear accessible executive report layouts.
learningObjectives: Write resilient YoY growth and cumulative MTD metrics over marked contiguous Date tables
Organize executive visuals cleanly with clear KPI hierarchy, accessibility, and dynamic RLS

sections.heading: 1. Time Intelligence & Decision-Driven Report UX
sections.content:
Great BI models fail if dashboards clutter 15 unlabelled pie charts onto a tiny canvas! Executive visual hierarchy guides eyes cleanly along an **F-pattern**: top banner holds concise **Headline KPIs with Variance Context** (Current vs Prior Year / vs Budget—never isolated numbers!), middle rows display **Time Trends** cleanly via line/bar charts, and bottom tables enable **Granular Drill-Through**.

Meanwhile, securing shared reports via **Dynamic Row-Level Security (RLS)** (`[SalesRepEmail] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()`) guarantees every regional rep views strictly their own territory inside one unified published dataset!

codeExamples.explanation: Structured top-to-bottom visual flow communicates executive insights in under 5 seconds.

keyPoints: Limit dashboards to cohesive restrained palettes avoiding misleading 3D charts or truncated bar Y-axes starting above zero!
Always attach comparison baselines (vs PY, vs Budget) directly inside KPI cards.
commonMistakes: Using unreadable nested pie/donut charts with 18 slices instead of a crisp sorted horizontal bar chart!

sections.heading: 2. Complete YoY & Dynamic RLS Expressions
sections.content: Inspect how clean `VAR`-based Time Intelligence handles missing prior-year baselines cleanly using `ISBLANK` checks.

codeExamples.code:
Revenue MTD = CALCULATE([Line Revenue], DATESMTD(DimDate[Date]))

Revenue YoY Growth % = 
VAR CurrentRev = [Line Revenue]
VAR PriorYearRev = CALCULATE([Line Revenue], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(DimDate[Date]))
RETURN
  IF(
    NOT ISBLANK(CurrentRev) && NOT ISBLANK(PriorYearRev),
    DIVIDE(CurrentRev - PriorYearRev, PriorYearRev)
  )

// Dynamic RLS Role Filter expression applied on DimEmployees:
// [WorkEmail] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()
codeExamples.explanation: Checking `NOT ISBLANK(CurrentRev)` hides future calendar months instead of rendering broken `-100%` dips mid-year!
codeExamples.expectedOutput: Clean percentage variance suppressing misleading -100% noise on future un-reported months

keyPoints: Place formatted helper metrics cleanly inside an organized `_Measures` display folder table.
commonMistakes: Starting bar chart quantitative axes arbitrarily at `90` rather than `0`, exaggerating trivial `2%` differences visually.

exercises.title: Design YoY Variance & Prevent Misleading Future Drops
exercises.objective: Guard YoY percentage growth cleanly against blank current periods and recommend clear visual replacements.
exercises.description: A dashboard renders `-100%` YoY growth for upcoming December months and plots 14 regional shares inside a cluttered circular pie chart.
instructions: Update `YoY Growth %` cleanly so future months with zero sales display blank instead of `-100%`.
Replace the 14-slice pie chart with a clearer accessible alternative visual.
exercises.starterCode:
YoY Growth % = 
VAR Cur = [Line Revenue]
VAR Prev = ...
RETURN ...
hints: Wrap return inside `IF(NOT ISBLANK(Cur) && NOT ISBLANK(Prev), ...)`.
exercises.submissionRequirements: Complete all checklist items, test assumptions, and document verification rationale.
evaluationCriteria: Addresses the root architectural/technical challenge accurately
Follows defensive industry standards and edge-case validation
exercises.solutionExplanation: Checking `NOT ISBLANK(Cur)` avoids noisy `-100%` artifacts on future quarters; a sorted horizontal bar chart renders 14 categories cleanly.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Why do bar charts with 12–15 categories strongly beat circular pie charts in executive BI design?

options.text: Human eyes judge linear aligned bar lengths and sorted order vastly more accurately than comparing angular pie slice areas
Pie charts cannot accept DAX measures
Bar charts bypass database Row-Level Security
Pie charts break Power Query folding

knowledgeChecks.explanation: Sorted horizontal bars make multi-category comparisons effortless and precise.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: What happens in a `Revenue YoY %` metric if you compute `(Cur - Prev) / Prev` in upcoming un-elapsed months where `Cur` is BLANK?

options.text: `Cur - Prev` evaluates to `-Prev`, rendering an alarming fake `-100%` line drop unless guarded with `NOT ISBLANK(Cur)`
Power BI hides future months automatically
DAX throws an exception halting report load

knowledgeChecks.explanation: Always guard period-over-period deltas against un-elapsed blank periods.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Which DAX function dynamically matches the currently logged-in report viewer's identity in Row-Level Security filters?
knowledgeChecks.explanation: `USERPRINCIPALNAME()` maps dynamically to the authenticated viewer's account UPN.
